Name: Management Cost: Planting
Description: Replanting: seedlings and planting, per unit area planted (planted and failed alike)

Name: Management Cost: Site Preparation
Description: Site preparation before replanting (pile and burn, or mechanical), per unit area

Name: Management Cost: Salvage Logging
Description: Salvage logging and haul cost per unit area (its timber revenue is Management Revenue: Salvage Timber)

Name: Management Revenue: Salvage Timber
Description: Revenue from the salvaged timber per unit area, falling with years since the fire (net = revenue - costs)

Name: Management Revenue: Harvest Timber
Description: Stumpage revenue of clearcut and selection harvest per unit area harvested: merchantable volume x removal share x regional stumpage price (src/forest-management.R)

Name: Management Cost: Fuel Treatment
Description: Fuel treatment (mechanical thinning, prescribed burn, thin and burn) per unit area treated (src/fuel-treatments.R)

Name: Management Cost: Rangeland Restoration
Description: Rangeland restoration (aerial or drill seeding, sagebrush planting, herbicide and seeding) per unit area treated, established and failed alike (src/management.R)
